image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a bagel topped with sesame seeds. The bagel has a distinct toroidal shape with a central hole. The crust appears pale golden to light brown, textured with numerous small, toasted sesame seeds. The surface shows slight irregularities and blistering typical of baked dough. Parts of other bagels are visible in the blurred background, suggesting a batch or display setting.
